newsitem.title: USA: Owens Corning names Thaman president of unit.
newsitem.headline: Owens Corning names Thaman president of unit.

text.p: Owens Corning named Michael Thaman as the company's new president of Engineered Pipe Systems, effective January 6.
Thaman, 32, replaces Scott Koepke, who left the company in November.
Thaman is currently general manager of Owens Corning's OEM Solutions Group, which provides fabricated insulation products and systems for original equipment manufacturers.
The OEM unit's principal markets include automotive, appliance, office furniture, and heating, ventilation and air conditioning. Thaman will remain responsible for this business.

Engineered Pipe Systems, responsible for developing the company's global pipe business, manufactures and markets large-diameter, glass-reinforced plastic pipe and other water transport products around the world.
